claude_proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations can impose a literal fixed save DC that is not derived from the wielder's spell save DC, proficiency bonus, or an ability modifier.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 8 hours.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Activated non-spell abilities need explicit targeting range metadata so target and area attachments do not trace as range Self by default.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of yourself.
